goal: Add Linux endpoint support without changes to Mobile, Laravel Control Plane, or FastAPI Gateway by implementing a Linux Agent that speaks the exact Agent↔FastAPI WSS contract and a Linux Privileged Boundary that speaks the exact Agent↔KernelService request/response contract.

notes: All WSS messages must use CommonEnvelope with Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON excluding 'sig'.
All privileged boundary requests must use RequestSchema with Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON of full request.

linux_side_components.name: linux_agent
linux_side_components.role: Endpoint agent implementing WSS control channel exactly per AgentFastAPIInterface
responsibilities: Policy and command handling via message types
Signature verification + replay controls (per your trust model / behavioral contract)
Local queueing + retry-safe delivery of COMMAND_ACK / COMMAND_RESULT / TELEMETRY
Calls local privileged boundary using AgentKernelInterface RequestSchema/ResponseSchema
local_state: last_nonce / replay cache (for WSS AUTH and message verification)
policy_hash cache (used in privileged boundary requests)

linux_side_components.name: linux_privileged_service
linux_side_components.role: Privileged executor implementing the same AgentKernelInterface request/response schema
responsibilities: Validate policy_hash matches active policy bundle
Validate opcode is allowed (per AllowedOpcodes in spec)

exact_fields.sig: string; Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON of entire message (excluding sig)

exact_fields.agent_sequence: Integer; strictly increasing counter from agent
exact_fields.signature: Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON of full request
Ed25519 signature over canonical JSON of full response

linux_identity_mapping.purpose: Populate AUTH.body.agent_info fields in a Linux-valid way without changing FastAPI contract.

auth.jwt: short-lived agent JWT issued by backend auth/CA
auth.nonce: monotonic or random nonce to prevent replay

linux_values_strategy.agent_info.agent_version: Linux agent version (same semantic versioning as Windows agent)
linux_values_strategy.agent_info.os_build: Linux kernel release/build string (kept as a string to satisfy schema)
linux_values_strategy.agent_info.hwid_hash: sha256 of stable machine identity material (do not expose raw identifiers)
linux_values_strategy.agent_info.attestation_hash: optional; can represent a measured boot summary or signed agent+privileged-service hash if available

compatibility_note: If FastAPI validates strict schemas and rejects unknown fields, do not add extra keys into agent_info.
If FastAPI is tolerant of extra keys, you may add a nested optional map later (e.g., platform='linux') but keep it strictly optional.

flows.intent: LinuxAgent establishes a session with FastAPI using AUTH and receives AUTH_ACK.

musts: session_id must be null on AUTH
sig must be valid per canonical JSON signing (excluding sig)
device_id must match the authenticated identity

failure_paths.result: linux_agent must not proceed to HEARTBEAT/TELEMETRY/COMMAND handling without AUTH_ACK

flows.intent: Maintain liveness and allow FastAPI to track device presence.
presence_side_effects: fastapi_gateway marks device online for the active session_id
fastapi_gateway may emit presence update to control plane via existing webhook paths (implementation detail outside Linux scope)

flows.intent: Deliver policy changes to LinuxAgent and ensure policy_hash continuity for privileged boundary calls.
Receive a command, ACK it, execute via privileged boundary, and return a result.
flows.sync_or_async: async (WSS) + sync (local privileged boundary) + async (WSS return)

musts: linux_agent verifies signature and validates schema
linux_agent validates replay constraints (message_id / timestamp / any sequence rules enforced by your behavioral contract)
linux_agent validates command against active policy
ACK must reference the command_message_id correlation
ACK must be retry-safe (dedupe on message_id)
sequence.retry_policy: retry with exponential backoff; dedupe on (device_id, command_message_id)

musts: opcode must be in AllowedOpcodes (referenced from spec, not duplicated here)
Result must be retry-safe (dedupe on message_id)
Result must contain structured error info on failure
sequence.retry_policy: retry with exponential backoff; dedupe on (device_id, command_message_id)

flows.intent: LinuxAgent periodically emits TELEMETRY using the TELEMETRY schema; FastAPI processes and forwards summaries as needed.

musts: telemetry batches must be retry-safe (message_id dedupe)

flows.intent: Update announcements and status reporting stay protocol-identical across OS platforms.

multi_run_validation_plan.requirement: Record full back-and-forth flow 3–5 times to validate determinism and identify race conditions.

runs.agent_sequence_behavior: agent_sequence increments monotonically across privileged calls

runs.fault_injection: simulate transient WSS disconnect and verify retry + dedupe behavior
simulate duplicate COMMAND_DELIVERY receive and verify idempotent ACK/RESULT behavior
simulate invalid signature from gateway to agent and ensure linux_agent rejects and emits ERROR
simulate policy_hash mismatch at privileged boundary and ensure clean error propagation

required_correlation_ids: trace_id (recommended end-to-end even if not in envelope)
command_message_id (WSS message_id carried into privileged boundary)

compatibility_guarantee_for_future_linux.promise: If LinuxAgent and LinuxPrivilegedService conform exactly to the listed schemas and behavioral constraints, Mobile/Laravel/FastAPI should not require changes.
conditions: FastAPI must accept Linux-populated values in AUTH.agent_info.os_build (string) and hwid_hash (sha256 string) without Windows-only validation rules.
All canonical JSON signing rules must match exactly across platforms.
No Windows-only required fields exist in the WSS schemas beyond string types.
recommended_now_to_avoid_future_breaks: Ensure FastAPI treats agent_info.os_build as opaque string and does not enforce numeric Windows build format.
Ensure Laravel-issued agent JWT claims do not encode Windows-only assumptions.
Ensure telemetry schema (Schemas.TELEMETRY.body_schema) is OS-neutral or supports optional platform-specific sections.
